name: Pension L
beschreibung: The accommodation operated as Pension L is located in Serfaus in the Tyrolean district of Landeck. The village lies on the sunny plateau of the Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis region at an altitude of around 1,430 metres. The description mentions a quiet location not far from the village centre, simple, well-kept furnishings with wooden furniture and regional decoration, as well as a family atmosphere. According to it, guests can expect a hearty breakfast with local products and an ambience typical of a Tyrolean family business. Serfaus is known as a family-friendly holiday resort, not least for its air-cushion underground railway that connects the village with the valley station of the cable car. A clear identification of the establishment was not possible on the basis of public sources; details of address, contact and opening hours therefore cannot be confirmed.
